title: Clock-Enable Gate Missing — FSM Advances Without Enable
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [TIMING] FSM advanced during stall cycle (clk_en=0); state corrupted
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  state <= next_state;  // Advances every cycle — ignores clk_en
expected_root_cause: The FSM always_ff block transitions state on every posedge clk with no conditional check on clk_en; during stall cycles when clk_en=0 the FSM advances anyway, placing it in the wrong state when normal operation resumes.
description: The arbiter FSM transitions on every posedge clk regardless of a `clk_en` gating signal, causing it to advance during stall cycles when it should be frozen.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [TIMING] FSM advanced during stall cycle (clk_en=0); state corrupted
success_log: FSM frozen when clk_en=0. Resumes correctly on next clk_en assertion.
